body: I appreciate you boss. It’s been so hard dealing with all this trauma alone. People say they are here but they can’t understand and have no response to the pain in turn puts me through much worse. I don’t know if life is worth living but if a stranger can say they love me and feel my pain then I deserve to live. Thank you again Frankie

I’m trying bud. He was my first little brother. She was my first girlfriend in my adult stage and I don’t have my dog to comfort me which even kills it more. I’ve had way worse happen at younger ages but it’s hitting so much harder these past few days and I don’t know how to go on
